purpose: Exploratory internal validation of one prespecified modified HDC after diagnostic review; not historical reconstruction or independent confirmation
scope: Existing development patients only; prior 52295-record test set excluded from fitting and scoring
outer_split: StratifiedKFold on unique patients, stratified by any SMM, then mapped to records
inner_split: 70/15/15 percent of outer-development patients for fitting/checkpoint selection/pruning-thresholds; stratified any-SMM; seeds 5300+fold and 5400+fold
preprocessing: Existing BinaryEncoder and StandardScaler specifications, fitted only on each fold's fitting records; prepared dataset is starting point; no outcome-informed exclusions

neural.selection: strict improvement in average_precision_score on checkpoint subset
neural.sampling: 2049 positive and 2047 negative examples per batch using supplied BalancedSampler

HDC.routing: random initial assignment; second iteration targets smaller absolute outcome residual from first-iteration branches, ties to left; feature-only router uses 0.5 threshold
HDC.router_epoch_selection: AP for routing labels on a separate 10 percent patient-disjoint subset of fitting patients; no outer/checkpoint/pruning outcomes used as router training targets
HDC.routing_iteration_selection: highest SMM AP on checkpoint subset among supported candidates; ties retain earlier iteration
HDC.child_detectors: reuse retained branch checkpoints as parent detectors for recursive growth; no unchecked replacement
HDC.acceptance: bottom-up completed subtree AP >= parent AP + 0.002 AND AUROC >= parent AUROC - 0.01 on pruning subset; otherwise keep parent
HDC.root: identical saved matched NN checkpoint, reused rather than independently initialized
HDC.support_failures: retain parent if no supported candidate; support rules are checked before fitting branches

randomness: single fixed seed schedule; neural role seeds deterministic from SHA256(fold,role,53); root NN/HDC identical

evaluation.primary: fold-specific AP and mean; paired HDC minus NN differences
secondary: sensitivity and PPV at pruning-derived 1% and 5% score-quantile cutoffs
evaluation.threshold_rule: >= quantile; report ties and achieved rates
evaluation.aggregation: unweighted mean of fold metrics; no pooling raw scores across folds
evaluation.uncertainty: 200 paired patient bootstrap replicates within each outer fold, then mean fold metric differences; conditional on fitted models, not model-training variability; exploratory
evaluation.execution: finish all model fitting before computing outer-fold metrics; no adaptive specification changes or seed search

limitations: Development data previously informed diagnostic choices; patient grouping does not test hospital transportability; no strong confirmatory superiority claim; comparisons do not isolate each simultaneous modification
